provider: Japan Ministry of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism (MLIT) / municipal publishers

request_contract.parameter_rules: Only the provider-documented GET /datacatalog/plateau-datasets catalogue operation is recorded. There is NO executable request authorization in this contract. No free-form URL/host, query parameters, city selector, GraphQL mutation, ZIP redirect, large body, source file download, retries or pagination is approved. Future bounded metadata GET must separately validate current API-specific terms, response byte cap, timeout and redirect/DNS policy and freeze one municipality and year before original-asset retrieval.

response_contract.format: JSON catalogue listing CityGML releases, including city/prefecture codes, municipality, source year, registration year, specification, feature types, URLs and file size when available.
response_contract.scientific_semantics: PLATEAU publishes municipal CityGML city-model releases with varying acquisition dates and LoD. Municipality/year is a source release selector, not a certificate of completeness. The API latest field can change as data are updated; exact release year, native identifier, geometry CRS, vertical datum and attribute missingness must be retained. CityGML LOD1 height abstractions, polygon overlap or construction-year fields must not be converted into insured properties or certified vulnerability/valuation data.

operational_constraints.rate_limit_notes: Provider describes this service as experimental and does not guarantee response schema, lifetime or service level. An unrestricted catalogue may exceed the proposed 64 KiB probe cap; do not execute until scope/response budget and terms can be proven. No request is authorized by this static contract.
operational_constraints.mutability_notes: Dynamic catalogue entries and 'latest' redirect targets change. A future receipt must record UTC, selected exact city/year, canonical catalogue request, code SHA, full bounded response bytes/SHA-256 and authoritative municipal licence identity; no mutable latest value as a model asset identity.

rights_and_policy.notes: MLIT FAQ describes programme data as multi-open-licensed and commercially reusable in principle, but the exact municipality/year CityGML licence/attribution, experimental API service automation and OpenCatastrophe redistribution/publication scope have not yet passed separate reviews. Do not extrapolate general policy to the API or to all city data.

notes: Exact official host and catalogue route are now recorded as a non-executable T0 access path. No request, byte receipt, API readiness evidence, rights grant, source-data admission, building match, risk exposure import or model execution was performed.
